messages:
Maya K: FYI — AWS Marketplace invoice INV-AWS-0426-9981 appears to have duplicate commit discount lines for CloudBridge reseller orders. Can AP hold payment until we confirm? :eyes:
Danielle - AP: Can you paste the offending lines so I can open a ticket?
Maya K: Pasting a short snippet from the marketplace report we received from AWS (redacted):
```
order_id,usage_type,units,unit_price,amount
mkt-2026-04-02-334,compute_hours,120000,0.0003,36.00
mkt-2026-04-02-334,commit_discount,120000,-0.00015,-18.00
mkt-2026-04-02-334,commit_discount (partner_applied),120000,-0.00015,-18.00
```
Liam (Finance): That pattern would double-apply the discount for partner-applied commits. Rough back-of-envelope impacted on this invoice looks like ~$23,450 across all affected orders — need definitive calc.
Arjun S: I'll run a join diff between marketplace-report.csv and commit-mapping.csv. My hunch: our reconciliation join used partner_order_id plus partner_id and CloudBridge had two records per order.
ap-bot: AP ticket AP-3421 created (assigned: Danielle - AP). Status: awaiting finance reconciliation.
Danielle - AP: @Rory (Finance Lead) heads up — this one is >$10k. We need manager sign-off to issue a credit memo.
Rory (Finance Lead): Reviewed the snippet. Approve provisional credit memo for $23,450 pending final reconciliation. Please reference INV-AWS-0426-9981 in the NetSuite memo and add note: "Marketplace duplicate commit discount — partner CloudBridge".
Liam (Finance): I'll attach the reconciliation CSV and breakdown to AP-3421 and create the NetSuite credit memo request. Action items: 1) Arjun to run definitive diff and produce per-order deltas, 2) Maya to share raw AWS marketplace dump, 3) Danielle to hold payment and prepare credit memo once finance confirms.
Maya K: Copy — I'll upload the full dump to the secure S3 link and ping here when done. I'll also ping CloudBridge to confirm they didn't resend discounts from their side.
Rory (Finance Lead): :white_check_mark: Thanks team. Keep updates in AP-3421 and put final amounts in the invoice comments.
Maya K: Will do.
